name: Bethlehem Ephrathah
line: Bethlehem Ephrathah is a small town in Judah that God chose as the place where a future ruler of Israel, whose origins are from eternity, would come.

moments.title: A ruler will come from here
moments.text: God says that although Bethlehem Ephrathah is small among the clans of Judah, One will come out of it to be ruler over Israel. His origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
